name: Sharebird Coach
description:
Make your Claude better at product marketing.

Claude drafts your launch plan, your messaging doc, your positioning. Sharebird Coach tells you where the draft is weak, checked against more than 500 product marketing leaders at Atlassian, OpenAI, Anthropic, Snowflake, and other companies.

REVIEW YOUR WORK

Ask Claude to review a launch plan and tell you what's missing. You get where the draft is thin, what a reader will push on, and which leader said so. Works on launch plans, messaging docs, positioning docs, sales decks, and resumes.

ALSO INCLUDED, UNLIMITED ON EVERY PLAN

- Search. Ask how experienced PMMs handle positioning when a product has two very different buyers.
- Pressure test. Talk through whether to launch with one persona or two.
- Templates. Ask Claude to draft a competitive battlecard from a Sharebird template.

PRICING

Free accounts get 3 reviews a month, and the count resets on the 1st. Search, pressure test, and templates are unlimited on every plan. Paid plans add more reviews.

YOUR DOCUMENTS NEVER LEAVE YOUR SESSION

Reviews run inside your Claude session. The document under review is never sent to Sharebird. Sharebird supplies the standard, and your Claude applies it to your document.

For search and retrieval, the connector receives only the queries your assistant sends on your behalf. It doesn't receive your conversation, and it can't read your files, your other connectors, or anything else in your Claude account.

Sharebird doesn't train models on your data, and your queries are never added to the Sharebird corpus. For retention, deletion, and IT review, see sharebird.com/trust.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sharebird Coach to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sharebird Coach to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://sharebird.com/api/mcp_advisor/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sharebird Coach MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sharebird Coach provides these MCP tools: fetch, get_document_spine, get_instructions, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sharebird Coach?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Sharebird Coach in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Sharebird Coach MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sharebird Coach requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sharebird Coach is developed by Sharebird. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
